<div class="card-body">
'''Leia Seeker''' is a [[Dark]] [[Weapon]] ([[Automated Weapon]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">レイア・シーカー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">1フォース使用して、未踏査の位置カードの、相手側に配備できる。自分の支配フェイズに、キャラクターと同じようにフォース消費して移動させることができる。レイアまたは能力値＜3の戦士と同じ場所についたら、そのうち1枚を選んで、ロストさせる。その際レイア・シーカーもロストする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Leia-Seeker-SWCA-67740.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">軍用リモート。特定の個人や、条件を指定しての追跡をプログラムされている。熱光学センサーできわめて正確に対象を追跡する。宇宙船に潜り込ませることも可能。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Leia Seeker.

'''Card text:'''
Use 1 Force to deploy on the opponent side of an unexplored location card. During your control phase, you may move it like a character by spending Force. If it is at the same location as Leia or a warrior of ability less than 3, choose one of them to be lost. Leia Seeker is also lost.

'''Lore:'''
Military remote. It is programmed to track a specified person or a specified condition. Heat-optical sensors track the target with high accuracy. It can also be slipped onto a starship.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese deploys on the opponent side of an unexplored location card (未踏査).
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Leia Seeker]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
